newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs slip, pork bellies start higher, then dip.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs slip, pork bellies start higher, then dip.

text.p: CME hog futures opened mostly lower as profit taking offset any support from higher cash hog prices, traders said.
Pork belly futures opened higher on support from a strong cash market but failed to hold as selling developed, floor sources said.
Stop loss selling added to the setback in pork belly futures with a bearish CME out-of-town report cited as a selling factor, they said.
At 0920 CDT, hogs were off 0.475 to up 0.200 cent per lb with July off most at 81.450 cents. Pork bellies were down 1.475 to 0.400 with July off most at 80.050 cents.
